detail.longDescription: On that note, does anyone know why there is STILL no good tooling for building cross arch or cross OS images? I’m just kinda surprised there isn’t like and HCL or other config layer that generates containerfiles for Podman which have OS and arch variations, and orchestrates all the junk you need to do with Qemu etc… Multi arch builds are sorta doable with docker buildx but I’ve so far only ever done it for trivial extensions to existing multi arch images. # podman # Docker # FreeBSD
